subject: E-2296: quota exceeded on macOS
body:
Good morning. My setup is LedgerLine 9.1.5, macOS 14.7. Whenever I start a sync
since Tuesday, the app displays "E-2296: storage quota exceeded".

On this computer the cache folder is now many gigabytes large. The files we
really store are a fraction of that.

I've already attempted logging out of my browser, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Aisha Bello (Caldera Foods)
